title: WHAT IS NEW LINES END AT A WHOLE SENTENCE
why: Seen on the 4K What is New screenshot of 2026-10-08: a line of the card was cut mid-sentence with dots (In co-op your teammate...) even when a whole sentence fitted before the limit. Now a line ends at its last full stop inside the limit when there is one, and is cut at a word with dots only when there is not.
now: Lines on the What is New card end at a full sentence where they can.
